newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Muslim Commercial Bank up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Muslim Commercial Bank up.

text.p: Pakistan's private Muslim Commercial Bank (MCB) rose 1.65 rupees, or 4.48 percent, to 38.50 rupees on Wednesday after the bank said it had cut its lending rates and had recovered bad debts, dealers said.
A turnover of 491,000 shares of the blue chip had been recorded at the Karachi bourse by 0658 GMT.
MCB said on Tuesday it had slashed the interest charged on loans by 1.09 percent effective from July 1, 1997.
It said a central bank scheme for recovery of loans had helped it recover 550 million rupees and a total of 1.5 billion rupees were likely to be recovered in 1997.
